content: Alice, I saw you at the north desk earlier alone. Later you mentioned Sofia was there with you. Can you clarify that for me?
I was alone at the north desk earlier. I only mentioned Sofia later because I wanted to talk to her about something else.
I see. It's just that I'm trying to get a clear account of the timeline regarding the donation. Thanks for clarifying.
The donation issue is serious, and I'm committed to finding the truth about what happened. I'm willing to cooperate fully.
I want to make sure everyone is being treated fairly during this investigation.
I agree, fairness is important. I hope we can resolve this without too much tension.
Sofia, I really value your support, and I want to make sure we handle this investigation with complete integrity.
I hope we can all work together to find the missing donation honestly.
Alice, you mentioned something about what you saw. Can you tell me more about what you actually observed?
Daniel, I can tell you what I observed, but I think we should discuss the details privately first.

Daniel, I'm willing to share my observations, but perhaps we can discuss them in private to ensure everything is handled correctly.
